Subscriptions, Pricing and Credits

Manages all subscription, billing, and usage tracking features

Scope:

Subscription Management

Credits, Usage Tracking & Limits

Pricing Plans

As Nexefy, we want to identify and establish a clear and effective pricing model, so that we can increase our revenue and maintain a competitive edge within the market.

Research

how many RTOs, how many courses, rate that RTOs die, rate that courses become outdated, how many courses each RTO makes, what industries are RTOs targeting most, how often they are auditing courses

identify trends in RTOs, course numbers into the future

Research

how long it takes to map a unit, how much a mapper person is paid, how much it costs to host that employee during that time (super, insurance, building rent, electricity, etc etc), identify how much it costs to audit a map

research pricing models for service based web products (shutter stock, anthropic, etc)

** consider credit/token based models and subscription based models

Identify the cost base for Nexefy to process a unit map, identify whether there is a ratio/linkage between API calls and cost and potential credits etc, if there is a link between how many units there are and credits etc.

Consider from a customer perspective how credits or pricing could be simplified so that its consistent

ie. 1 credit per map, per criteria, per? do we need to provide an estimate before they map

ie. they hit map and it says this will cost 11 credits to map. or even a preview of this next to the map button.
